verdict.rationale: A live probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document at learning.postman.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key). The docs also confirm a programmatic Postman API that such a spec would describe. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec download, confirmation that the spec covers the full Postman API surface (vs. a docs-site subset), independent corroboration of its completeness and freshness.
